description: This source file contains Ruby code for generating HTML documentation from XML module definitions related to the lighttpd2 project. It defines classes for parsing XML, generating HTML pages, and organizing documentation like modules, chapters, and index pages.

classes.name: Documentation
classes.description: Base class for generating HTML documentation pages, handling HTML structure, table of contents, and content rendering.

classes.name: GenericModuleDocumentation
classes.description: Represents a generic module documentation, capable of parsing XML to generate module-related documentation content.

classes.name: ModuleDocumentation
classes.description: Subclass of GenericModuleDocumentation that handles specific module elements like actions, setups, options, and sections.

classes.name: AngelModuleDocumentation
classes.description: Subclass for handling 'angel-module' elements with specific parsing for 'item' elements.

classes.name: ChapterDocumentation
classes.description: Represents chapter documentation, parsing chapters, sections, examples, and descriptions.

classes.name: ModuleIndex
classes.description: Creates an index page listing modules, actions, setups, and options with links.

classes.name: IndexPage
classes.description: Creates a general index page linking to other documentation pages.

classes.name: AllPage
classes.description: Aggregates all documentation pages into a single HTML page.

methods.name: loadXML
methods.description: Loads an XML file and creates the appropriate Documentation subclass instance based on root element.
